_comment: Systems tab: each container tile links to its UI (url) and its code (source). Edit freely, no deploy needed, re-read every 20s with docker ps. Tailnet host is risingcreek-ai.taild0b4c6.ts.net (tailscale serve) or the tailnet IP 100.92.25.23 where a port is bound there directly. Verified against `tailscale serve status` + `docker ps` 2026-08-23.
_comment_kasmUrl: kasmUrl is Claude's own path to the same tile, NOT Jake's — it's the docker-network address the shared Kasm Chrome (openclaw-browser, 172.18.0.3) can reach over CDP, used only by the 'kasm' secondary action / server/lib/kasm.js. From inside that container, tailnet hosts (100.92.25.23:*, *.taild0b4c6.ts.net:*) are NOT reachable, but the risingcreek-net bridge (172.18.0.0/16) is, INCLUDING container-to-container hops whose host port is only published to 127.0.0.1 (tc-chat, tc-mcp) — host-loopback-only publishing does not block bridge-internal traffic. The one exception found the other way: the host bridge gateway itself, 172.18.0.1, is NOT reachable from containers on this network (verified live 2026-08-23 via `docker exec openclaw-browser curl`, 3 retries, consistent connect-timeout on port 3080 and port 22 alike, while a host process bound specifically to 172.18.0.1 on a different port answered fine) — so anything that runs bare on the host, not in a container (the dashboard itself included), gets kasmUrl:null here; it isn't in this file's container list at all since it never shows up in `docker ps`. Verified per-container with `docker exec openclaw-browser curl -sk -m 5 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' <candidate>`, any HTTP status (even 404) counting as reachable, timeout (000) as not. Re-probe after any container is recreated with a new IP.
